shots.description: Title screen: the player stands on the beach at the north edge at golden hour, the bay and low sunset sun behind, towers ahead, start overlay up.
Driving: the player cruises down a long avenue in a stolen car at golden hour, traffic ahead including slow beachfront cruisers, chase camera behind.
Police chase: two pursuit cars on the player's bumper, sirens flashing, three wanted stars, a roadblock going up ahead on Marina Row with the dispatch banner up.
Mission: the player on foot at the gold beacon for The Big Score, Dana Vega's objective on screen, peds on the street nearby.
